title: Shared definitions for payments-fintech-compliance skill schemas
description: Shared $defs that per-skill schemas in this plugin commonly redefine. Per-skill schemas should $ref these via "../_defs.json#/$defs/<name>" rather than redefining the same enums and shapes inline. Plugin-specific extras (payments_regulator_enum, payment_rail_enum, baas_partnership_role_enum) sit alongside the base definitions.

severity_enum_with_moderate.description: Variant ladder used by exam-letter ingestion (CFPB, OCC, FDIC, state MTL examiners) and audit findings where 'moderate' has settled meaning.

confidence_label.description: Author confidence in the artifact as a whole.

owner_role.description: Named firm function or role with accountability (e.g., 'Chief Compliance Officer', 'Head of Payments Risk', 'BSA Officer', 'Head of Partner Bank Oversight', 'Head of Card Operations', 'Money-Laundering Reporting Officer'). Never an individual person.

human_review_gate.description: Embedded human-review-gate descriptor. Common payments / fintech gates: partner-bank pre-launch oversight, BSA/AML risk-rating refresh, Reg E error-resolution disposition, money-transmitter licensing change attestation.

payments_regulator_enum.description: Primary or relevant payments / fintech regulator. State-MTL-regulator is used as a placeholder for the lead state in a multi-state MTL footprint; the named lead state is captured in a separate field.

payment_rail_enum.description: Payment rail or instrument the artifact addresses. Drives applicable rules (Reg E, Reg CC, NACHA, card-network rules, BSA travel-rule treatment).

baas_partnership_role_enum.description: Role in a banking-as-a-service / partner-bank arrangement. Drives Interagency Third-Party Risk Management responsibilities and the OCC / FRB / FDIC partner-bank oversight expectations published in the 2023 BaaS guidance.
